text:
mike_support: Customer Amy (acct: amy-co) opened a ticket — after the v4.1 canary they see tool/function calls failing intermittently with schema validation errors and 403s. She pasted a repro payload and a bunch of failing request ids.
customer_Amy: seeing json_schema error: "args not valid: missing 'document'" for many calls. Also some calls return 403 from our tool proxy (auth_token missing). Started after rollback window 02:30 UTC.
customer_Amy: repro steps: POST /v1/chat with model=v4.1, tools=[search,docs], body.args truncated (last char chopped) sometimes. Happens ~30% of calls.
mike_support: can you share one full failing request id and truncated payload? Also asking for last 10 request_ids. I've added ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/AMY-1132
customer_Amy: request_ids: r:2765432121, r:2765432137, r:2765432142. Example payload: {
  "query": "summarize the Q4 plan",
  "document": "Shows up as 'documen' sometimes"
}
jun_infra: interesting — truncation could be on client side or during tokenization/serialization in the model adapter. We saw a tokenizer change in v4.1 release notes (byte-pair tweak). Could be related.
oliver_eng: looking at logs for r:2765432121 — upstream to tool-proxy shows header Authorization: "Bearer " (empty) for 3/10 attempts. That would cause 403. Why would header be dropped only for some routed variants?
eli_oncall: is routing switching between model variants? If v4.1 has new selector heuristics it might be routing some requests to a legacy tool pair with different auth method.
mike_support: customer reports latency spike too (p95 up from 220ms -> 1.2s) and billing increase — they retried requests from their client when error occurred which multiplied tokens consumed.
canary-bot: v4.1 canary rollout stats: 12% traffic, function-invoke error rate +3.1% over baseline, auth failures localized to region us-west-2. Patch: routing fallback engaged in 0.4% of cases.
sara_pm: priority: escalate to eng-runtime and infra. We need quick repro, capture raw request bytes, and decide on rollback if root cause confirmed. Customer is enterprise with dedicated contract.
oliver_eng: quick checks: (1) capture full raw tcp payloads for r:2765432121..2142, (2) check model-adapter serialization path for truncation, (3) inspect router metadata that populates Authorization header for tool-proxy calls.
jun_infra: running a sweep now across us-west-2. Already seeing correlation: truncated-body requests map to adapter process ids running kernel build name v4.1-kernel-b. Suspect a buffer-size change in adapter when content-length > 2048.
mike_support: shared a short repro script for customer to run (asking them to attach --raw-req output). Script: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?model=v4.1&call_tools=true
customer_Amy: ran curl with --trace-ascii and attached file. Also saw the Authorization header intact on client side but empty upstream.
oliver_eng: aha — payload JSON occasionally missing final char which causes adapter to fall back to different serializer that strips Authorization when proxying. That's a bug. Reproduced locally with payload sizes around 2100 bytes.
eli_oncall: mitigation options: 1) pause v4.1 canary rollout (recommended until fix deployed), 2) force routing key to v4.0 for enterprise customers (hotfix config), 3) add temporary proxy rule to reject truncated payloads and return 400 (prevents silent 403 and retries).
sara_pm: customer impact high. Recommend step 2 + notify sales/CS. Can we do a hotfix to pin their account to v4.0 immediately?
jun_infra: can do account pin config change now. Will push in 5m and confirm.
mike_support: I'm posting customer notification draft in ticket for Amy.
oliver_eng: code fix: adapter commit patch will validate Content-Length vs actual bytes and avoid falling back serializer. Preparing PR with test cases. Will also add metric for truncated_payload_count.
canary-bot: deployment note: paused canary in us-west-2 at 2765432160 per request. Monitoring for drop in error rate.
mike_support: thanks — I'll update Amy and keep thread open. If anyone hits additional request_ids, drop them here.
customer_Amy: thanks team — appreciate fast response. I'll hang on for pin confirmation and update when I see errors stop.
